packageRules.description: Runtime minor/patch updates are bundled weekly by the update-deps skill: keep them listed in the Dependency Dashboard and open a PR only on demand
One weekly auto-merged devDependencies bundle instead of one PR (and one patch release) per package
@types/node must track the Node major we actually run (see .nvmrc and engines.node): newer typings make tsc accept APIs that are missing at runtime, and skipLibCheck hides the mismatch

engines.node is published to npm as part of package.json: keep it a permissive major range instead of bumping it to the current patch, which makes every consumer on an older 22.x emit 'Unsupported engine' on install. The exact development version stays pinned in .nvmrc
